reason: The estimate uses only the north region (N=633 of 2000) with no stated justification. It also omits most of the 2020 pre-period confounders (export share, R&D, foreign/family ownership, union share, credit score, sector, listed). 'No effect' is drawn from a non-significant coefficient with a wide SE (0.40), which is absence of evidence, not evidence of no effect. I could not re-run the analysis; this verdict rests on reading the code and report.
